observations.title: P4A | New South Wales portal
notices: Election review 30 October: NSWEC declared Barry Knight elected uncontested for Cobar on 29 October; no voting is required. This declaration supersedes the earlier 28 November poll timetable. Coffs Harbour and Hunters Hill South Ward polls remain 12 December, with nominations closing 11 November at noon Sydney (AEDT). Paul Amos resigned effective 14 October; Hunters Hill announced Marc Lane's immediate resignation on 15 October. State Parliament composition retains its 23 October review; no full federal roster audit is claimed.
Completed - Barry Knight elected uncontested; no voting required
